svg.title: SpaceLab system architecture
svg.desc: Components live in frontend/ (browser), backend/ (API gateway), rag_server/ (retrieval and AI context), data/ (datasets, generator and SQLite), docs/ (diagrams and guides), and tests/ (shared verification). The browser uses local Python or Heroku Gunicorn. Shared routes read 103 bundled synthetic records across 28 Malaysian locations with SQLite edits and CSV additions on every request. Python filters and ranks all matching records, computes numeric rankings and complete listings, and optionally calls Ollama. A default-off web switch adds external Ollama search excerpts. Dataset records and web references remain separate. Explorer edits update maps, answers and downloads immediately. Natural Earth outlines are bundled locally. SQLite is local; Heroku persistence needs durable storage.
svg.text: BROWSER · frontend/ · HTML / CSS / JAVASCRIPT
Assistant · Data explorer · Architecture
Question + topic + answer style + model mode + Web search switch (off by default)
Explorer: application groups · edit / save / cancel · CSV import · map · current dataset downloads
APPLICATION HOST · backend/
Local Python OR Heroku Gunicorn
python -m backend.server OR Gunicorn WSGI
The browser and API are served by the same app.
CURRENT DATA · data/record_store.py
Bundled JSON + SQLite edits / additions
Seed: 103 observations / 28 places; imports can add records.
Read merged records after each edit or CSV import.
PYTHON API GATEWAY · backend/webapp.py
Validation · queries · edits · CSV import · exports
POST /api/ask · POST /api/records/{id} · GET /api/records
GET /sample-data/observations.{csv,json,geojson} · bundled assets / prompt / health
Read / save
DATASET EVIDENCE · rag_server/rag.py
Filter all records, then select by intent
Exact place / state / topic constraints; no fixed source cap.
General questions → BM25; top / bottom → numeric sort.
“List all” → every matching record.
WEB CONTEXT · rag_server/web_context.py
Web switch on → Ollama Cloud search
POST /api/web_search · up to 5 external search excerpts
Web switch off → no search request; dataset evidence only.
Search errors / no results → explicit notice.
DATASET RESULTS / OFFLINE / FALLBACK
Computed results or source excerpts
Rankings and listings are computed in Python.
Offline mode and model failures use labelled excerpts.
Missing dataset evidence / live requests → abstain.
OPTIONAL AI GENERATION · /api/chat
Ollama-compatible model service
Dataset records + optional separate web evidence → model
Validate source IDs; web answers must cite web evidence.
With web context, computed results stay intact.
API RESPONSE → BROWSER
Answer first · Clarification · collapsible References
Dataset records (synthetic) and external web links / excerpts appear in separate reference groups.
Inline source IDs and duplicate Refs lines are hidden in the displayed answer.
Response JSON export includes evidence, actual mode, notices and web-search status.
EXPLORER & MAP
Save edits → refresh all data consumers
Validate fields; detect stale edits; persist in local SQLite.
Summary / quality labels update from saved values.
Map: bundled Natural Earth outlines + location markers.
Shared projection; Peninsular / East Malaysia panels.
HOSTING & EVIDENCE LIMITS
Credentials and persistence stay server-side
Model key + optional dedicated Ollama search key.
Local SQLite survives local app restarts.
Heroku needs durable storage across dyno replacements.
Web evidence does not validate invented measurements.
CSV IMPORT · BROWSER → backend/webapp.py → data/record_store.py
Grouped Explorer → CSV template → upload selected rows
POST /api/records/import · text/csv · UTF-8 · up to 2 MB / 2,000 rows
Validate every row → one SQLite transaction → update matching IDs / add new IDs.
Return counts + current records; refresh groups, map and totals; clear the previous answer.
Bundled files stay unchanged. SQLite overrides and additions feed questions and all exports.
Any invalid row → reject the entire upload. Only synthetic teaching observations are supported.
